book.name: Roma
book.title: Roma Roma Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Tena, Iuda vazeḡa moneo naginiꞌe manoḡa? Ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌeteꞌe moneo manoḡaꞌe nagini?
Ḡau niduꞌa moneo manoḡaꞌe ḡehaḡa. Ibite geno Badiꞌaꞌa ane ḡoere Iuda azaḡa ziniro.
Vaze nuꞌa Badiꞌa ḡoere mene mae ḡihinine, naginiꞌa fureraꞌuma? Ze Badiꞌa ḡoere mene mae ḡihineꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, Badiꞌaꞌa ane ḡoitore ḡoeꞌa mene haḡaiꞌumahe?
Mene hune zu! Badiꞌaꞌe ane ḡoitore ḡoeꞌa haḡae huniꞌuma! Vaze niduꞌaꞌe ḡuriro azaḡa, u Badiꞌaꞌe hugano haḡaeꞌohe. Buka Zaḡoḡanoꞌe ꞌahige rae mirihiro,

content.text: “Badiꞌaꞌa ḡoerine, vaze niduꞌa ane ḡoereꞌe duduḡa rae mae ḡihiniꞌuma,
ebu ani kotao mae ohonine, aniꞌa agire azaḡa raharahaziꞌuma.”

content: Rehano emeḡeꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa veꞌoḡa uꞌano, Badiꞌa daꞌo duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌeꞌa ufeta deheru fureraune, eme nagini reꞌuma? Badiꞌaꞌa emeḡe mazao zamaḡa ḡugineꞌetaꞌaꞌe mene duduḡa rae reꞌumahe? (Aꞌe mene eḡe ḡoere, rehano e vazeꞌa raꞌeteꞌe ibiḡano raꞌohe.)
Mene hune! Badiꞌaꞌe mene duduḡa rae reine, ani nougenouge raha azaḡa kotaziꞌuma?

Rehano vaze nuꞌa ꞌahige reꞌuma, “Eḡeꞌa ḡurire haḡaeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, Badiꞌa daꞌo huga rae raꞌeteꞌeꞌa borofe fureraune, vazeꞌa ane ni ufeta mae ḡihiniꞌuma. ꞌOugine Badiꞌaꞌa nougadu eꞌe vaze sauꞌa rae raenaꞌa, eꞌe veꞌoḡa rae raꞌohe?”

Rehano zeḡe ḡoere hugaꞌe, “Manoḡaniꞌa furerafine, eme haḡai sauꞌa haḡaihi,” rae raꞌeteꞌe heuḡa. Vaze nuꞌe, “Paulo duḡuruꞌe ꞌouge ḡoereꞌohe,” rae ḡurireꞌenaꞌa, emeḡe rae sausaufeꞌohe. Vaze ꞌuguḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa kotazine manoḡa.
Badiꞌa Ubumao Duduḡa Vazeḡaꞌe Oꞌoꞌa
ꞌOugadu nagini reꞌuma? Eme, Iuda azaḡaꞌe Iuda mene azaḡa ufeta vitizogahe? Mene hune! Iuda azaḡa zu Iuda mene azaḡa niduꞌa idane haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌenaꞌa, radiuꞌeteꞌe emeḡeꞌa amahi rae fureniro.
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro,

content.text: Vaze niduꞌa Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo ḡihuradu vaḡiniro,
ebu zeḡe niduꞌaꞌe huga oꞌoꞌano reiro.
“Ogorabizeꞌe rune iduḡaniꞌa bohatu radadu ḡezauꞌeteꞌe heuḡa.
“Hebezeo ḡoere sauꞌa zu vaze zama sausauzeꞌeteꞌeꞌa iriꞌaveꞌohe.”
zeꞌa onameꞌeteꞌe ibiḡano vaze ruizeꞌohe zu aduga ziniꞌohe,
zeꞌe zama roḡeḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa aḡuꞌa.”

content: Izidi eme edeḡa, Mose goro ḡoeꞌano reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa niduꞌaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegote radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ziꞌohe. Aꞌe vaze niduꞌa haḡaize sauꞌa moneo ḡoere ꞌahoga mene rouga veize, zu raha azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe rae furenoga veize raꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotadu Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa. Mose goro ḡoeꞌanonoꞌo emeꞌa haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe edereꞌohe.
Fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano Badiꞌa Ubumao Duduḡa Raꞌohe
Rehano izidi Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa raꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa fureraro. Aꞌe mene Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa, rehano Mose goro ḡoeꞌa zu peroveta azaḡaniꞌa rae fureniroteꞌe ibiḡa.
Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa raꞌetaꞌaꞌe Iesu Keriso mazao fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, ebu fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa veize raꞌohe. Badiꞌaꞌa vaze niduꞌa mazao idane haḡaeꞌohe.
Vaze niduꞌaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa haḡadu Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo areꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa ḡihiꞌaḡanonoꞌo fararo.
Rehano Keriso Iesuꞌa vaze haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo bohaze buziro ꞌahine, Badiꞌaꞌa ze mazao manoḡa fureniro ebu ane ubumao zeꞌe duduḡa rae reiro. Aꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ziniroteꞌe ḡahunoneḡa.

Badiꞌaꞌa haḡaize sauꞌa rae modifine, Iesu Keriso dibuꞌadu ruḡa soroniro. Iniu ane ru mae ḡihineꞌeteꞌe azaḡa haḡaize sauꞌaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa rae modeꞌohe. Badiꞌaꞌa ꞌouge haḡairotaꞌaꞌe, vazeꞌa ibite haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa sauꞌa moneo aniꞌa zamaḡa obone tiꞌenaꞌa, haḡaize sauꞌa iḡine modadu Badiꞌa aneꞌa bare duduḡa rae furenifine reiro.
Badiꞌaꞌa izidi madaḡano aniꞌe duduḡa rae fureneꞌetaꞌaꞌe, aniꞌe duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe ihozifine zu aniꞌa Iesu mazao fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe duduḡa rae huzeꞌeteꞌe ihozifine raꞌohe.
ꞌOugadu vazeꞌa nagini niguniꞌuma? Oꞌoꞌa hune! Nagi goro ḡoeꞌa hina Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae reꞌuma? Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotadu ꞌouge reꞌumahe? Mene! Fieꞌeteꞌe goroḡa ḡoeꞌa uꞌano ꞌouge reꞌuma.
Emeꞌe, mene Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, rehano fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe mae ḡihineꞌohe.
Badiꞌaꞌe Iuda azaḡa Badiꞌa daꞌohe? Ani zuni Iuda mene azaḡa Badiꞌahe? Hube hune, ani zuni Iuda mene azaḡa Badiꞌa.
Badiꞌaꞌe tibuhuga. Aniꞌe ahiri rana iḡuri haḡairoteꞌe azaḡaꞌe zeḡeꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano duduḡa rae reꞌuma, zu ahiri rana iḡuri mene haḡairoteꞌe azaḡa zuni zeḡeꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano duduḡa rae reꞌuma.
Tena emeꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa rae reꞌumahe? Mene hune! Emeꞌe Mose goro goeꞌa mae gigane ohoneꞌohe.
